I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it on 9 Jun 2026 in #central-team, which Tobias is a member of. The Eastbank receiving-door import file is attached to that ticket. I also passed on the open issue from that post: the import file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow Agrisupply's booking sheet uses 01/02. That had to be fixed before anyone reimported, to avoid duplicate doors.
